definition: The group of words that name the parts of a style's dossier, from how to identify the style to the evidence behind it. Each one heads its own part.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`section` holds the parts of a style's dossier, each record heading its own part", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
